subject: Password reset email never arrives
body: I clicked 'forgot password' three times but no email ever shows up. I checked spam too. How long does the reset link last and what am I doing wrong?
reference_answer: Reset links are valid for 60 minutes. Check spam/quarantine, confirm you used your sign-up email, and add no-reply@nimbus.io to safe senders, then request a fresh link. Note: SSO users must reset via their identity provider, not this flow.

subject: What are the API rate limits on Pro?
body: We're on Pro and want the exact API rate limit per minute, the burst allowance, and which headers tell us how many requests remain.
reference_answer: Pro allows 1,200 requests/minute sustained with bursts up to 2,000 in a 10-second window, applied per organization. Remaining quota is reported via X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

subject: Refund for annual Pro plan bought 5 days ago
body: I upgraded to the annual Pro plan five days ago but we're going another direction. Can I get a refund? It was annual.
reference_answer: Yes. New annual subscriptions qualify for a full money-back refund within 14 days of purchase. Since you're at 5 days, request the refund from Settings -> Billing -> Help (or contact support with your invoice number) and it will be returned to your original payment method within 5-10 business days.

subject: How do I connect Nimbus to Slack?
body: I'd like failure notifications to post into our #ops Slack channel. What are the steps, and is it available on Starter?
reference_answer: Slack is available starting on the Starter plan. Go to Settings -> Integrations -> Slack -> Connect, authorize the Nimbus app via OAuth, pick a default channel, then choose per workflow which events (success, failure, or both) post to Slack.

subject: URGENT: all production deployments failing, we are DOWN
body: Every workflow is failing in production right now and customers are affected. We're Enterprise with an SLA. Fix this now or we escalate to our account manager and legal.

subject: Delete all my personal data under GDPR
body: Under GDPR Article 17 I formally request that you delete my account and erase all personal data you hold about me. Confirm in writing when complete.

subject: Difference between Starter and Pro?
body: What do I get going from Starter to Pro - seats, workflows, support response time? Does Pro include SSO?
reference_answer: Pro ($99/mo) gives unlimited workflows, 20 team seats, 90-day run history, priority email support (8h), SSO, and all integrations. Starter ($29/mo) is capped at 25 workflows, 5 seats, 30-day history, and 48h email support without SSO.

subject: Getting intermittent 429 errors
body: Our integration sometimes gets HTTP 429 even though we don't think we send that many requests. How should we handle it and why is it intermittent?
reference_answer: Intermittent 429s usually mean short bursts exceed the burst window. Honor the Retry-After header, use exponential backoff with jitter, batch and cache where possible, and spread scheduled workflows so they don't all fire at the same second. Pro customers can request a temporary limit increase from support.

subject: Add a Terraform provider for Nimbus
body: We manage everything as code. Do you have a Terraform provider so we can define workflows in HCL? If not, is there a supported workaround today?
reference_answer: Nimbus does not currently offer a Terraform provider; it's on the roadmap and there is no supported workaround today. Contact support so we can track demand for it.

subject: I was double charged this month
body: My card shows two identical charges for my Pro subscription this month. I have one account. Please refund the duplicate; invoice numbers are in my billing history.

subject: Where do I download my invoices?
body: Our finance team needs PDF copies of past invoices for expense reporting. Where can I find and download them?
reference_answer: Open Settings -> Billing -> Invoices. Each invoice shows its date, amount, and status; click Download for a PDF or View for line items. Add your business name and VAT/Tax ID under Tax Details if you need them on the invoice.

subject: Are you SOC 2 compliant and do you have a DPA?
body: Our security team is reviewing vendors. Is Nimbus SOC 2 compliant, and do you offer a DPA for GDPR? How do we obtain copies of both?
reference_answer: Yes. Nimbus is SOC 2 Type II audited annually; the report is available to customers under NDA via support or your account team. A GDPR Data Processing Addendum (DPA) is available and can be countersigned from Settings -> Legal -> DPA or through support.

subject: Can we get EU data residency?
body: Our compliance team requires that data stays in the EU. Does Nimbus support EU data residency, and on which plan?
reference_answer: Data is hosted in the US (us-east) by default. EU data residency (eu-central) is available on Enterprise plans and is selected at onboarding.

subject: My step times out at 15 minutes
body: One of my workflow steps keeps timing out after about 15 minutes. Can I increase the timeout, and what's the maximum?
reference_answer: The default per-step timeout is 15 minutes and the maximum configurable timeout is 60 minutes. Increase the step timeout, or split the long step into smaller steps if it needs more than 60 minutes.

subject: Do you integrate with Datadog?
body: We use Datadog for monitoring. Is there a native Nimbus integration for it?
reference_answer: There is no native Datadog integration today; it's on the roadmap. Contact support so we can track demand. In the meantime, outbound webhooks can POST run events to an endpoint you control.
